login.sub: Sign in to manage your store.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Sales, open orders and quote requests show here once your first product is live.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Products you add appear here with price, stock, MOQ and review status. Bulk import from CSV or Excel arrives with the catalog release.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyBody: Retail and company orders for your products land here. Ship them and add tracking from each order.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.emptyBody: When a company buyer requests a quote, set unit prices, lead time and validity here, then send the offer.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyBody: Buyer questions about your products and quotes appear here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Sales, top products and buyer reports build up as orders come in.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.emptyBody: Each delivered order adds a payout line: order total minus commission and refunds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyBody: Store profile, staff, shipping options and KYC documents are managed here.
